envelope.description: Pane decisions through the queue; the waiting list removed

body.title: Pane decisions through the queue; the waiting list removed
body.summary: Change submitExternal in chat-panel.ts to resolve the target chat (the shown session, or the one the panel opens on), save it, and submit through ChatQueueWorker.submit with origin 'review-pane', returning 'queued' or { kind: 'unavailable', note } (note for blank text, no CLI, a full or busy queue, and defensively no worker). Change ExternalSubmitResult, the review host's notifyChat dependency type, ChatHandOver and decisionResultLine together so the pane says 'Sent to the chat; it waits its turn in the outbox.' or 'The chat could not be told: <note>'. Remove waitingExternal, drainExternal and every call to it; keep the webviewReady reset that dropExternal performs under a clearer name. Rewrite the chat-panel.test.ts submitExternal suite and the docs-review-decision tests that pinned 'sent', the old wording and the drain order, and add the queue-path tests on the real-store host harness. This stays one L task because the result type is shared by the chat host and the review host through extension.ts's binding, and the old suite runs on hosts without a queue, so a split would leave the typecheck or the suite red between tasks.
acceptanceChecks: a pane decision sent while a turn runs is a review-pane row in the chat's outbox, the running turn and its waiting card are untouched, and it runs when the turn ends
with the panel closed, submitExternal opens it on its session, saves the chat and queues one row that runs in order once the webview is ready
blank text, no CLI, a full queue and a busy queue each return unavailable with their own note and queue nothing
the review pane's result line reads 'Sent to the chat; it waits its turn in the outbox.' for queued and 'The chat could not be told: <note>' for unavailable; 'sent' no longer exists
waitingExternal and drainExternal are gone and a decision queued before the panel or window closes is still in the queue file afterwards

tests.name: chat-queue-outbox-host.test.ts: a review-pane decision sent while a turn runs waits in the outbox as origin review-pane, leaves the running turn and its waiting card alone, and runs when the turn ends
chat-queue-outbox-host.test.ts: submitExternal on a closed panel opens it, saves the chat, queues a review-pane row, and the message runs in order once the webview is ready
chat-queue-outbox-host.test.ts: a decision queued before the panel or window closes is still in the queue file afterwards
chat-queue-outbox-host.test.ts: submitExternal with no CLI, blank text, a full queue and a busy queue each returns unavailable with its own note and queues nothing
docs-review-decision.test.ts: a queued hand-over shows 'Sent to the chat; it waits its turn in the outbox.', unavailable carries the note, failed and none are unchanged, and no 'sent' wording remains
